scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix shifttea && npm install --prefix firebase/functions && npm run build --prefix firebase/functions
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "next,emulators,seed" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,green" "npm run dev --prefix shifttea" "cd firebase && npx firebase emulators:start --project dev" "wait-on tcp:8080 tcp:9099 && npm run seed"
scripts.dev:metrics: SHIFTTEA_FIRESTORE_METRICS=1 concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "next,emulators,seed" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,green" "npm run dev --prefix shifttea" "cd firebase && npx firebase emulators:start --project dev" "wait-on tcp:8080 tcp:9099 && npm run seed"
scripts.deploy:dev: cd firebase && npx firebase deploy --project dev
scripts.deploy:prod: cd firebase && npx firebase deploy --project prod
